meanings.usage: 指新年的决心或决定，常用make a resolution
由mental加-ly构成，修饰动词或形容词
形容令人印象深刻或感到畏惧的事物
形容缺乏变化、重复的事物
指达到目标或获得成就
形容长期形成的难以改变的习惯
指未能实现目标的失望感
形容有强烈愿望和目标的
形容认真不懈地做某事
指出卖或泄露秘密，也可指暴露内心感受
指用言语嘲笑或羞辱他人
指兴趣、力量等逐渐减少
指导致失败或毁灭的事物
指控制自己行为的能力

examples.en: The same old favourites recur year in year out with monotonous regularity.
examples.zh: 同样的喜好年复一年地以单调的规律性重复出现。

examples.en: Do a thousand and one jobs about the house.
We never have time to carry them out.
examples.zh: 我们从没有时间去实现它们。

examples.en: When we slip back into our bad old ways.
examples.zh: 当我们重新回到坏习惯时。

examples.en: I applied myself assiduously to the task.
examples.zh: 我勤奋地致力于这项任务。

phrases.usage: 悄悄溜下；蹑手蹑脚地走下

examples.en: I managed to creep down into the living room.
I fended off the taunts and jibes of the family.
examples.zh: 我挡开了家人的嘲笑和讽刺。

examples.en: Little by little the eleven minutes fell to zero.
examples.zh: 渐渐地，十一分钟降到了零。

examples.en: I soon got back to my old bad habit of dozing off in front of the screen.
examples.zh: 我很快又回到了在屏幕前打瞌睡的坏习惯。

phrases.usage: 对某事保密；不告诉别人

examples.en: This year I attempted to keep my resolutions to myself.
examples.zh: 今年我试图对自己的决心保密。

grammar.title: 动词不定式作表语 (Infinitive as Predicative)
grammar.structure: 主语 + be + to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 动词不定式可以在句中作表语，说明主语的内容或目标 用于说明计划、意图、命运等，或与resolution, aim, goal等名词搭配

examples.en: My resolution is to read more.
Our aim is to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是按时完成项目。

grammar.title: 结果状语从句 (Consecutive Clause)
grammar.structure: so + adj/adv + that / such + (a/an) + adj + n + that
grammar.definition: 由so...that或such...that引导，表示某种原因导致的结果 用于描述由于前面情况而产生的自然结果

examples.en: The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes so that I could finish them quickly.
examples.zh: 每日锻炼只持续了十一分钟，所以我能很快完成。

examples.en: It was such cold weather that nobody wanted to go out.
examples.zh: 天气太冷了，没有人想出去。

grammar.title: 定冠词the的特指用法 (Definite Article 'the' for Specific Reference)
grammar.definition: 定冠词the用于特指谈话双方都知道的特定事物 当名词被上下文限定、或者谈话双方都知道的事物时使用the

examples.en: The next morning the whole family trooped in.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，全家人鱼贯而入。

examples.en: The dog is sleeping under the table.
examples.zh: 那只狗正在桌子下面睡觉。

patterns.pattern: We resolve to + 动词原形

original.en: We resolve to get up earlier each morning.
original.zh: 我们决心每天早上早起。

imitations.en: I resolve to exercise more this year.
She resolves to learn a new language.
imitations.zh: 她决心学习一门新语言。

patterns.pattern: It is/was + this/that + that + 动词

original.en: It was this that betrayed me.

imitations.en: It was the cold weather that kept me indoors.
imitations.zh: 正是寒冷的天气让我待在室内。

imitations.en: It was her kindness that saved the day.
imitations.zh: 正是她的善良挽救了局面。

patterns.pattern: Little by little + 主语 + 动词

original.en: Little by little the eleven minutes fell to zero.
original.zh: 渐渐地，十一分钟降到了零。

imitations.en: Little by little the snow melted away.
Little by little he recovered his confidence.

patterns.pattern: Past experience has taught us that + 从句

original.en: Past experience has taught us that certain accomplishments are beyond attainment.
original.zh: 过去的经验告诉我们，某些目标是无法实现的。

imitations.en: Life has taught us that patience is a virtue.
imitations.zh: 生活教会我们耐心是一种美德。

imitations.en: Experience has taught me that honesty pays off.
imitations.zh: 经验告诉我诚实是有回报的。

lines.en: The New Year is a time for resolutions.
lines.zh: 新年是下决心的时候，至少在大多数人的心里会编排出一份“应做什么”和“不应做什么”的令人生畏的单子。

lines.en: Mentally, at least, most of us could compile formidable lists of 'dos' and 'don'ts'.
lines.zh: 相同的决心以单调的规律年复一年地出现。

lines.en: The same old favorites recur year in year out with monotonous regularity .
lines.zh: 我们决心每天早晨起得早些；吃得少些；多花点时间与孩子们一起做游戏；做大量的家务；对不喜欢的人友善一些；小心驾车；每天都要带着狗散步；等等。

lines.en: We resolve to get up earlier each morning, eat less, find more time to play with the children, do a thousand and one jobs about the house, be nice to people we don't' like, drive carefully, and take the dog for a walk every day.
lines.zh: 以往的经验告诉我们有些事是办不到的。

lines.en: Past experience has taught us that certain accomplishments are beyond attainment .
lines.zh: 如果我们烟瘾大，戒不掉，那是因为屡戒屡败，失去信心。

lines.en: If we remain inveterate smokers , it is only because we have so often experienced the frustration that results from failure.
lines.zh: 我们大多数人想自我完善却遭到失败，这是因为我们的规划过于宏大，而又根本没有时间去实施。

lines.en: Most of us fail in our efforts at self-improvement because our schemes are too ambitious and we never have time to carry them out.
lines.zh: 我们还犯有一个根本性的错误，即把我们的决心向大家宣布。

lines.en: We also make the fundamental error of announcing our resolutions to everybody so that we look even more foolish when we slip back into our bad old ways.
lines.zh: 这样一旦滑回到那些老习惯上去，我们在别人的眼里会显得更加难堪。

lines.en: Aware of these pitfalls , this year I attempted to keep my resolutions to myself.
lines.zh: 我深知这些问题，于是，今年我对自己的计划要严加保密，只给自己定下两项适中的任务；每天早上锻炼身体，每天晚上多看点书。

lines.en: I limited myself to two modest ambitions: to do physical exercise every morning and to read more of an evening.
lines.zh: 新年除夕举办的一次通宵晚会，使我理直气壮地在新年头一天免去了这两项任务。

lines.en: An all-night party on New Year's Eve provided me with a good excuse for not carrying out either of these new resolutions on the first day of the year, but on the second, I applied myself assiduously to the task.
lines.zh: 不过，新年第二天，我全力以赴地照着去做了。

lines.en: The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes and I proposed to do them early in the morning before anyone had got up.
lines.zh: 早锻炼一共只有11分钟，我打算在别人起床之前进行。

lines.en: The self-discipline required to drag myself out of bed eleven minutes earlier than usual was considerable.
lines.zh: 这就要求我比平时早11分钟把自己从床上拽起来，这种自我约束是很艰苦的。

lines.en: Nevertheless, I managed to creep down into the living room for two days before anyone found me out.
lines.zh: 不过开头两天我还是成功地蹑手蹑脚地来到楼下起居室，被谁也没发现。

lines.en: After jumping about on the carpet and twisting the human frame into uncomfortable positions, I sat down at the breakfast table in an exhausted condition.
lines.zh: 我在地毯上跳来蹦过去，扭曲身子，摆出各种姿势，弄得浑身不舒服，然后坐到桌边吃早饭，一副筋疲力尽的样子。

lines.en: It was this that betrayed me.
lines.zh: 正是这副模样泄露了我的秘密。

lines.en: The next morning the whole family trooped in to watch the performance.
lines.zh: 第二天早晨全家人结队来到起居室看我表演。

lines.en: That was really unsettling, but I fended off the taunts and jibes of the family good-humouredly and soon everybody got used to the idea.
lines.zh: 这真叫人不好意思，但我心平气和地顶住全家人的嘲笑和奚落。

lines.en: However, my enthusiasm waned .
lines.zh: 不久，大家对我习以为常了，而这时我的热情却减退了。

lines.en: The time I spent at exercises gradually diminished.
lines.zh: 我花在锻炼上的时间逐渐减少，慢慢地从11分钟减到了零。

lines.en: Little by little the eleven minutes fell to zero.
lines.zh: 到了1月10日，我恢复了原来的作息时间。

lines.en: By January 10th, I was back to where I had started from.
lines.zh: 我辩解说，早晨少耗费精力锻炼，晚上下班回家看书时头脑更清醒些。

lines.en: I argued that if I spent less time exhausting myself at exercises in the morning, I would keep my mind fresh for reading when I got home formwork Resisting the hypnotizing effect of television, I sat in my room for a few evenings with my eyes glued to book.
lines.zh: 有几天晚上，我极力摆脱了电视的诱惑，坐在自己的房间里，两眼盯在书上。

lines.en: One night, however, feeling cold and lonely, I went downstairs and sat in front of the television pretending to read.
lines.zh: 可是，有一天夜里，我感到又冷又孤单，便来到楼下坐在电视机前假装看书。

lines.en: That proved to be my undoing , for I soon got back to my old bad habit of dozing off in front of the screen.
lines.zh: 这下我可完了，因为不一会儿，我就恢复了以前的坏习惯，在屏幕前打起瞌睡来。

lines.en: I still haven't given up my resolution to do more reading.
lines.zh: 但我还没有放弃多看些书的决心。

lines.en: In fact, I have just bought a book entitled How to Read a Thousand Words a Minute.
lines.zh: 事实上，我刚买来一本叫《一分钟读一千字的诀窍》的书。

lines.en: Perhaps it will solve my problem, but I just haven't had time to read it!
lines.zh: 也许这本书能解决我的问题，但我一直还没时间去看这本书！

questions.q: What marked the end of the writer's New Year resolutions?
questions.zh: 是什么标志着作者新年决心的终结？
questions.a: The night he went downstairs, sat in front of the television pretending to read, and soon dozed off in front of the screen.
questions.aZh: 那一夜他下楼坐在电视机前假装看书，很快就在屏幕前打起瞌睡来。
questions.hint: 答案在课文结尾：That proved to be my undoing, for I soon got back to my old bad habit of dozing off in front of the screen.

questions.q: According to the text, why do some people remain inveterate smokers?
questions.zh: 根据课文，为什么有些人烟瘾大、戒不掉？
questions.a: Because they have so often experienced the frustration that results from failure.
questions.aZh: 因为他们屡戒屡败，饱尝失败带来的挫败感，失去了信心。
questions.hint: 见课文：If we remain inveterate smokers, it is only because we have so often experienced the frustration that results from failure.

questions.q: Why do most of us fail in our efforts at self-improvement?
questions.zh: 我们大多数人想自我完善为什么却失败了？
questions.a: Because our schemes are too ambitious and we never have time to carry them out.
questions.aZh: 因为我们的规划过于宏大，而根本抽不出时间去实施。
questions.hint: 见课文：our schemes are too ambitious and we never have time to carry them out。

questions.q: What were the writer's two modest ambitions this year?
questions.zh: 今年作者给自己定下的两项适中的任务是什么？
questions.a: To do physical exercise every morning and to read more of an evening.
questions.aZh: 每天早上锻炼身体，每天晚上多看点书。
questions.hint: 见课文：I limited myself to two modest ambitions: to do physical exercise every morning and to read more of an evening.

questions.q: What does the writer's experience suggest about making New Year resolutions?
questions.zh: 作者的经历对我们立新年决心有什么启示？
questions.a: Resolutions should be kept to oneself and made modest and practical, for ambitious schemes without time and self-discipline are bound to fail.
questions.aZh: 决心最好藏在心里、定得切合实际，因为脱离时间与自律的宏大计划注定失败。
questions.hint: 综合全文，尤其是 announce 决心的教训、two modest ambitions 以及最终故态复萌的结局。

translation:
新年是下决心的时候，至少在大多数人的心里会编排出一份“应做什么”和“不应做什么”的令人生畏的单子。
相同的决心以单调的规律年复一年地出现。
我们决心每天早晨起得早些；吃得少些；多花点时间与孩子们一起做游戏；做大量的家务；对不喜欢的人友善一些；小心驾车；每天都要带着狗散步；等等。
以往的经验告诉我们有些事是办不到的。
如果我们烟瘾大，戒不掉，那是因为屡戒屡败，失去信心。
我们大多数人想自我完善却遭到失败，这是因为我们的规划过于宏大，而又根本没有时间去实施。
我们还犯有一个根本性的错误，即把我们的决心向大家宣布。
这样一旦滑回到那些老习惯上去，我们在别人的眼里会显得更加难堪。
我深知这些问题，于是，今年我对自己的计划要严加保密，只给自己定下两项适中的任务；每天早上锻炼身体，每天晚上多看点书。
新年除夕举办的一次通宵晚会，使我理直气壮地在新年头一天免去了这两项任务。
不过，新年第二天，我全力以赴地照着去做了。
早锻炼一共只有11分钟，我打算在别人起床之前进行。
这就要求我比平时早11分钟把自己从床上拽起来，这种自我约束是很艰苦的。
不过开头两天我还是成功地蹑手蹑脚地来到楼下起居室，被谁也没发现。
我在地毯上跳来蹦过去，扭曲身子，摆出各种姿势，弄得浑身不舒服，然后坐到桌边吃早饭，一副筋疲力尽的样子。
正是这副模样泄露了我的秘密。
第二天早晨全家人结队来到起居室看我表演。
这真叫人不好意思，但我心平气和地顶住全家人的嘲笑和奚落。
不久，大家对我习以为常了，而这时我的热情却减退了。
我花在锻炼上的时间逐渐减少，慢慢地从11分钟减到了零。
到了1月10日，我恢复了原来的作息时间。
我辩解说，早晨少耗费精力锻炼，晚上下班回家看书时头脑更清醒些。
有几天晚上，我极力摆脱了电视的诱惑，坐在自己的房间里，两眼盯在书上。
可是，有一天夜里，我感到又冷又孤单，便来到楼下坐在电视机前假装看书。
这下我可完了，因为不一会儿，我就恢复了以前的坏习惯，在屏幕前打起瞌睡来。
但我还没有放弃多看些书的决心。
事实上，我刚买来一本叫《一分钟读一千字的诀窍》的书。
也许这本书能解决我的问题，但我一直还没时间去看这本书！
title: New Year Resolutions
subtitle: 新年决心

lead.question: 作者的“新年决心”为何接连失败？究竟是什么最终让他的读书计划泡了汤？
lead.warmup: 每到新年，人们总要立决心：早起、少吃、多陪孩子。可这些决心年年重复，却总难实现。作者总结出原因：目标太宏大、无暇实施，还忍不住向人宣布。于是今年他改了策略，把决心藏在心里，只定两项适中任务——早晨锻炼、晚上读书。通宵晚会、艰苦的自律、家人围观轮番考验着他，且看决心如何消退。
goals: 掌握 resolution、resolve、self-discipline、ambition 等本课核心词汇及搭配。
理解不定式在句中作宾语、同位语、目的状语等成分的用法。
体会现在完成时（I still haven't given up / I have just bought）的表达效果。
学会用 However、Nevertheless 等词表达转折与让步，梳理叙事逻辑。
lead.summary: 课文以幽默自嘲的口吻讲述作者两次新年决心的失败：锻炼计划因热情减退、时间从十一分钟递减到零而归零；读书计划则败给电视的诱惑，一晚在屏幕前打瞌睡后故态复萌。作者借此点明决心难行的根源——目标过于宏大、无暇实施、又轻率宣布，并暗示唯有切合实际的计划与持久的自律才能真正奏效。
lead.tips: 注意区分动词 resolve（决心做，resolve to do sth）与名词 resolution（决心，常与 make/keep/give up 搭配）；另 carry out 意为“实施、执行”，不要与 carry on（继续）混淆。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我们决心每天早晨起得早些，吃得少些。
exercises.a: We resolve to get up earlier each morning and eat less.
exercises.note: resolve to do sth 决心做某事

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 can't 改写 Certain accomplishments are beyond attainment.
填空：I still ______ (not give) up my resolution to do more reading.（用正确时态）
exercises.note: 现在完成时 haven't given up

exercises.q: 改错：We also make the fundamental error of announce our resolutions to everybody.
exercises.note: 介词 of 后接动名词

exercises.q: 填空：I have just bought a book ______ (entitle) How to Read a Thousand Words a Minute.
汉译英：我给自己定下两项适中的任务：每天早上锻炼身体，每天晚上多看点书。
exercises.a: I limited myself to two modest ambitions: to do physical exercise every morning and to read more of an evening.

exercises.q: 句型转换：The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes. But the self-discipline required was considerable.（用 Although 合并）
exercises.a: Although the daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes, the self-discipline required was considerable.

quiz.q: 作者认为大多数人想自我完善却失败，主要原因是什么？
options: Their schemes are too ambitious and they never have time to carry them out.
They simply forget what they have resolved to do.
They cannot afford the time and money to improve themselves.
They are too lazy to get up early in the morning.
quiz.note: 见课文 schemes are too ambitious

quiz.q: 课文中的 inveterate smokers 指的是一类怎样的人？
options: Those who smoke only on special occasions.
Those who have never tried to stop smoking.
Those who have smoked for a long time and can hardly give it up.
Those who smoke secretly in the evening.

quiz.q: 作者说把新年决心向大家宣布，会带来什么后果？
options: Your friends will help you carry out your resolutions.
You look even more foolish when you slip back into your bad old ways.
You will feel more confident and work harder.
Your family will stop laughing at you.

quiz.q: 今年作者对自己的决心采取了什么新做法？
options: He wrote his resolutions down and showed them to everybody.
He gave up making any resolutions at all.
He joined an all-night party to celebrate the New Year.
He kept his resolutions to himself and set only two modest ambitions.

quiz.q: 作者所说的自我约束（self-discipline）具体指什么？
options: The effort of dragging himself out of bed eleven minutes earlier than usual.
The determination to eat less at breakfast every morning.
The courage to fend off the taunts of his family.
The patience to read a thousand words a minute.

quiz.q: 关于多读书的决心，作者最后是怎么处理的？
options: He has completely forgotten it and never buys any books.
He gave it up after falling asleep in front of the screen.
He still hasn't given it up and has just bought a book to help him read faster.
He has already finished reading a thousand words a minute.
quiz.note: 见 I still haven't given up...
